subject.title: [Bug]: [Regression] 2026.5.27: Codex app-server turn-completion stall returns ("Codex stopped before confirming the turn was complete") — regression of #84076 (fixed by #85107)

question: Should OpenClaw define one canonical recovery contract for Codex turns with unmatched native tool results and no final reply, or split that contract from the existing missing-turn/completed timeout tracker?
rationale: The remaining cases span upstream protocol incompleteness, persisted session/tool state, user-visible delivery, and unsafe replay policy; choosing their shared invariant determines the correct fix boundary and test ownership.

options.title: Define a unified terminal-outcome contract
options.body: Treat missing tool results and omitted turn completion as one Codex lifecycle contract requiring terminal tool accounting plus a safe visible outcome without replay.

options.title: Keep separate canonical trackers
options.body: Retain separate ownership for missing turn/completed timeouts and missing native tool-result finalization, sharing only diagnostics and evidence.

recommendation.title: Define a unified terminal-outcome contract
recommendation.body: Treat missing tool results and omitted turn completion as one Codex lifecycle contract requiring terminal tool accounting plus a safe visible outcome without replay.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged recovery work and issue discussion provide the clearest available evidence about the current recovery boundary.
